description: This file defines a server-side code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'ExamResult.aspx'. It handles the page load event to display and update exam results for a user, interacting with session data and a SQL Server database. It also provides navigation button handlers to other pages in the application.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult.aspx page, managing the display and update of a user's exam result information.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves session data, updates user info in the database, and displays exam details.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the Login page.
